title.en: the saturday flea market in vysočany.

line.en: the bleší trh u elektry is open 06:00 to 14:00 on saturdays and sundays. walk the stalls in the morning; pedestrian entry about 50 czk.
line.de: der bleší trh u elektry ist samstags und sonntags von 06:00 bis 14:00 offen. morgens die stände ablaufen; eintritt zu fuß etwa 50 czk.
line.tr: bleší trh u elektry cumartesi ve pazar 06:00 ile 14:00 arası açık. sabah tezgahları gez; yayalar için giriş yaklaşık 50 czk.

sparks.why: Bleší trhy Praha, U Elektry, Vysočany, saturdays and sundays 06:00 to 14:00 (antikport.cz listing); 7 Nov is a saturday.
